summary.ru: Поздняя Цинь — одно из 16 варварских государств, возникших в IV веке в Северном Китае после распада царства Ранняя Цинь. Существовало в 384—417 годах.
summary.en: Qin, known in historiography as the Later Qin or Yao Qin, was a dynastic state of China ruled by the Yao clan of Qiang ethnicity during the Sixteen Kingdoms period in northern China. As the only Qiang-led state among the Sixteen Kingdoms, it was most known for its propagation of Buddhism under its second ruler, Yao Xing, who sponsored the Madhyamakin monk, Kumārajīva to translate Sanskrit Buddhist text into Chinese.
